projects.searchPlaceholder: Tìm kiếm by key or name

projectPanel.noMembersHint: Nobody can reach this dự án until someone is invited to it.

teams.empty: No teams match this tìm kiếm.

teamPanel.noProjectsHint: This team owns no dự án yet.
teamPanel.noProjectMatches: No dự án match this tìm kiếm.

general.mcpEnabled: Enable MCP on new dự án
general.mcpEnabledHint: A new dự án is in its team's MCP reach from the moment it is created.

authentication.registrationHint: Who may tạo an account on this instance.

open.label: Open
open.description: Anyone who reaches the sign-up page can tạo an account.

invite.label: Invite only
invite.description: An account can only be created through an invite link.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: No new accounts. Existing ones keep signing in.

authentication.signInHint: How people đăng nhập. The options that send mail stay off until a provider is configured.
authentication.needsProvider: Set up the Email provider under Integrations first.
authentication.requireVerificationHint: A new account must confirm its address before it can đăng nhập.
authentication.magicLinkHint: Offer signing in with a link sent by email, alongside the password.
authentication.trustProviderEmailsHint: Google and OpenID Connect sign a person in to the account that already has their address, confirmed here or not. Turn this on only where you control who can register at the provider.
authentication.emailPasswordHint: Offer the sign-in and sign-up form. Turn it off to let people in through a sign-in provider only.
authentication.needsSso: Set up a sign-in provider under Integrations first.

storage.fileSizeHint: The largest single file an upload may carry. A bigger file is refused before it is stored.
storage.attachmentHint: Applies to issue tệp đính kèm, files pasted into a mô tả, and tệp đính kèm added by agents.
storage.avatarHint: The profile picture people upload for their account.
storage.mimeTypesHint: One content type per line. Leave empty to accept any file.
storage.mimeTypesNote: A line is a full type (application/pdf) or a wildcard (image/*). Files already stored are kept whatever the list says.
storage.quotaHint: Total attachment storage one dự án may use. 0 means no limit.
storage.quotaNote: Once a dự án reaches the quota, new uploads are refused until someone deletes tệp đính kèm.

telegram.botConfigured: People connect their Telegram account by opening a chat with this bot from their profile.
telegram.botMissing: Tạo a bot with @BotFather in Telegram and paste its token here.
telegram.botTokenHint: The token is verified with Telegram when you lưu, so a wrong one is refused here rather than failing silently later.
telegram.resolvedHint: Resolved from the token. This is the bot people will see when connecting.

email.providerHint: Choose one provider. Credentials are stored encrypted.
email.fromHint: Required for Resend. With SMTP it defaults to the username.
email.teamNotificationsHint: Let teams deliver their thông báo through this provider instead of configuring one of their own. Each team still chooses whether to use it.
email.testHint: Send a real message with the current cài đặt without saving them.
email.testConfigureFirst: Enable a provider and add its required credentials first.

authProvider.googleConfigured: An address without an account gets one; an address that already has a confirmed account signs into it.
authProvider.googleMissing: Add the client ID and secret first.
authProvider.redirectUriHint: Register this on the OAuth client in the Google Cloud console. Google refuses the sign-in if it does not match exactly.
authProvider.oidcConfigured: An address without an account gets one; an address that already has a confirmed account signs into it.
authProvider.oidcMissing: Add the discovery URL, client ID and secret first.
authProvider.discoveryUrlHint: Your provider's .well-known/openid-configuration. The authorization, token and userinfo endpoints are read from it.
authProvider.oidcLabelHint: Names your provider on the sign-in button. Leave it empty for a generic label.
authProvider.scopesHint: Separated by spaces. openid is required; profile and email fill in the name and address.
authProvider.oidcRedirectUriHint: Register this as a redirect URI on the client at your identity provider. The provider refuses the sign-in if it does not match exactly.

scim.provisioningConfigured: Your identity provider creates, updates and deactivates accounts on this instance.
scim.tokenHint: The bearer token your identity provider sends. It is shown once; generating a new one stops the old one working.
scim.baseUrlHint: Point your identity provider at this address.
scim.groupsHint: The groups your identity provider has pushed. The list is theirs; what each group grants is set here.
scim.groupsEmpty: No groups have been pushed yet.
scim.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}

tokenDialog.title: Generate a SCIM token
tokenDialog.description: The token is shown once and cannot be read quay lại. Any token already in use stops working.
tokenDialog.createdDescription: Copy it into your identity provider now. It cannot be shown again.

mappings.title: What {group} grants
mappings.description: Thành viên of this group join the dự án listed here. Removing a dự án takes away the memberships this group gave it.
